summary: Repair the confirmed in-scope AlembicCore lifecycle contract defect discovered during Plugin integration. Add a public, awaited, provider-independent terminal Recipe-identity removal contract and wire knowledge:deleted plus lifecycle transition to deprecated through it, separately from the existing entry_<id> legacy-vector retirement used after live upsert/reconcile. The contract must preserve authoritative Recipe identity until the storage implementation has removed base residue and every known vector generation; it must not infer terminal intent from current-reader visibility or canonical IDs. Keep query-time Search/Prime reader-only and keep live Recipe update replacement intact. Provide a connected Core consumer/call chain and public exports for AlembicPlugin to implement; do not edit Plugin or copy its generation store into Core. RED/GREEN must reproduce target-only-in-old-rollback-generation with current generation containing another Recipe and base containing legacy/canonical residue, then prove provider-offline delete and deprecate remove terminal truth and rollback cannot resurrect it. Also cover live upsert retaining the Recipe, awaited flush/error semantics, and existing Core lifecycle/generation suites. Return one clean Core commit with exact parent/commit, changed public symbols, focused/full test commands, compatibility notes, and two-stage self-review.
designIntent: Make terminal Recipe lifecycle intent an explicit awaited Core contract so storage implementations can remove the Recipe from base and every known generation without confusing live legacy-entry retirement.

targetTasks.summary: Implement and prove an explicit Core terminal Recipe vector-removal port; no Plugin edits.
